name: engine: washing the screen while braking stops the engine
_notes: A real behavioural hazard in engine-repin.json, not a compiler bug: the
stop gesture is CHORD = brake AND washer, and there is no guard against
the driver pressing the washer while on the brake. VI5 WASHER_PUMP even
encodes the author's awareness of the overlap (washer AND NOT brake), but
CHORD (VI1) has no such exclusion, so the run-latch still decrements.
Keep this trace: any compiled equivalent MUST reproduce it. A compiler
that 'helpfully' adds the guard has changed the program.
